shortDescription: Indonesia’s loan growth rose 13.36% year-on-year in August 2026, following a 13.58% increase in July, which marked the strongest pace since August 2014.Bank Indonesia expects loan growth to reach 8–12% for the full year, supported by accommodative macroprudential policies.

children: Indonesia’s loan growth rose 13.36% year-on-year in August 2026, following a 13.58% increase in July, which marked the strongest pace since August 2014.
Bank Indonesia expects loan growth to reach 8–12% for the full year, supported by accommodative macroprudential policies.

title: Indonesia Loan Growth Stays Robust
